title: BlogPostCreateRequest
description: blog.post-create-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/blogs/:handle/posts on OpenVibe.Blog (blog.post.create; a member who may write, or a service acting for one; X-OV-Origin: ai makes an AI draft that needs a person's review). A new draft at revision 1: title required. Unknown fields are ignored; refusals are problem+json (post.invalid_title, post.too_long, post.invalid_visibility, post.invalid_slug, post.too_many_tags, post.invalid_series, …).

title.description: Whitespace collapsed; required, at most 200 characters.

visibility.description: Default public; members gates it behind the blog's VIP entitlement (OpenVibe.VIP decides).

slug.description: Default from the title; lowercase letters, digits and dashes (a taken one gets a number).

tags.description: At most 20 tags of at most 50 characters.

series.description: A series id (ser_…), a new series title, or { title }; null or empty leaves the series.

citations.description: Sources: a URL (with retrieved_at) or an OpenVibe.Sources item id; a quote may be text or { text }. At most 100 are kept.

authorship.description: hybrid or imported authorship details; an AI service (X-OV-Origin: ai) writes AI drafts that need review.
